# Python dependencies for the Jupyter analyses under analysis/*/
#
# Companion to env/install_r_deps.R, which covers the R/Quarto side.
#
# Install with:
#     python3 -m pip install --user -r env/requirements-python.txt
#
# Every package here is either peer-reviewed or a de-facto community standard;
# the notebooks delegate all statistics to them rather than hand-rolling.
#
# Versions below are lower bounds. Verified working set on `nectar`
# (Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.10.12), 2026-08:
#     numpy 2.2.6   pandas 2.3.3    scipy 1.15.3     scikit-learn 1.7.2
#     torch 2.13.0  pydeseq2 0.5.2  anndata 0.11.4   formulaic 1.2.2
#     pingouin 0.6.1  statsmodels 0.14.6  matplotlib 3.10.9  seaborn 0.13.2
#     joblib 1.5.3  nbformat 5.11.0  nbclient 0.11.0  ipykernel 7.3.0

# --- numerics and data ------------------------------------------------------
numpy>=1.26            # Harris et al. (2020) Nature 585:357
pandas>=2.0            # McKinney (2010) Proc. SciPy
scipy>=1.11            # Virtanen et al. (2020) Nature Methods 17:261

# --- machine learning -------------------------------------------------------
scikit-learn>=1.4      # Pedregosa et al. (2011) JMLR 12:2825
                       #   PCA, PLSRegression, Ridge, KNNImputer,
                       #   LeaveOneGroupOut, DummyRegressor
torch>=2.0             # Paszke et al. (2019) NeurIPS 32
                       #   autoencoders, VAE, Adam, autograd
joblib>=1.3            # parallel permutation nulls (scikit-learn's own backend)
lazypredict>=0.3       # Pandala (2019), github.com/shankarpandala/lazypredict
                       #   fits every scikit-learn regressor through one common
                       #   pipeline and returns a ranked leaderboard; drives the
                       #   40-model screen in analysis/predictions/

# --- omics ------------------------------------------------------------------
pydeseq2>=0.5          # Muzellec et al. (2023) Bioinformatics 39:btad547
                       #   Python port of DESeq2; supplies the VST
anndata>=0.10          # pydeseq2 dependency

# --- statistics -------------------------------------------------------------
pingouin>=0.5          # Vallat (2018) JOSS 3:1026 -- ANOVA effect sizes (eta^2)
statsmodels>=0.14      # Seabold & Perktold (2010) Proc. SciPy
formulaic>=1.0         # R-style formulas -> design matrices

# --- plotting ---------------------------------------------------------------
matplotlib>=3.8        # Hunter (2007) CiSE 9:90
seaborn>=0.13          # Waskom (2021) JOSS 6:3021

# --- notebook ---------------------------------------------------------------
jupyterlab>=4.0        # Kluyver et al. (2016) ELPUB
ipykernel>=6.0
nbformat>=5.9
nbclient>=0.9          # headless execution of the notebooks
nbconvert>=7.0         # --execute the notebooks and render .html / .md
